name: JSL Foods Inc, Texas
old_description: Ask us about our ability to deliver 14 points of customization to support your entrée, side, or brand!
about:
JSL Foods Inc operates from Humble, Texas. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides custom food manufacturing services, offering what it describes as 14 points of customization for entrées, sides, and private-label brands. Its production processes include ingredient selection, recipe creation, testing, and qualification. The facility operates under a Safe Quality Food (SQF) program and follows Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).

JSL Foods serves food brands and manufacturers seeking custom entrée and side products. Its client base includes companies requiring USDA, Organic, and Kosher certified production.

The company emphasizes its quality and safety programs as differentiators, citing high 90s audit scores from consumers and third-party regulators. It maintains certifications including USDA, Organic, Kosher, NSF, and OSHA compliance, and states a commitment to continuous improvement of its protocols.
